## LitQuest

LitQuest is an interactive web and mobile application designed to address adult literacy challenges by making classic literature into visual novels.

### Skills Showcased

\- Web development and Application Prototype

\- Collaboration with a team of 5

\- Designing technology for social impact and accessibility

\- ReactJS, JavaScript, Figma, MongoDB
